title: Sending for Joe Oliver and his first night at the Royal Garden
summary: Garland was in Chicago before Oliver and sent for him when the Royal Garden opened; Oliver went over big using mutes.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline
